Corollary
[Surface monotonicity of $tR$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0293 ↗ rem:chow-ii-surface-trace-harnack-nonnegative-curvature 1. ch15:15.9\group Surface Harnack Estimates

On a surface Ricci flow with $R\ge 0$, $tR(x,t)$ is nondecreasing. For an ancient flow, $R(x,t)$ is nondecreasing.
Proof

\sketch Set $V=0$ in the weak trace estimate. For an ancient flow translate the initial time to $\alpha $ and let $\alpha \to -\infty $.

□
